title: Lee pitches Seoul as "reliable action partner" at Korea-ASEAN summit in Manila
detail: President Lee Jae Myung told the Korea-ASEAN summit in Manila that Seoul shares the bloc's 2045 vision and unveiled AI-alliance and cultural-industries initiatives; he also pitched Korea-Mekong cooperation on AI, critical minerals and cross-border crime. The trip continued to the ASEAN Plus Three and East Asia summits and on to APEC in China.
